hints.title: Level Order Traversal
hints.text: Traverse the binary tree level-by-level using breadth-first search.

hints.title: Level Boundary Tracking
hints.text: When inspecting node u at index i of a level, check if i + 1 < level_size.

hints.title: Immediate Right Neighbor Return
hints.text: If u is the last node on its level, return null; otherwise return the next node popped from the queue.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Level order traversal visits each node once in linear time with queue memory bounded by maximum level width W.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Depth-first search requires passing and matching exact level coordinates across separate recursive branches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Breadth-first search keeps only nodes from the current level in memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Breadth-first level-order traversal with level size loop inspection.
